title: Yash and Radhika Pandit Mark 10 Years of Engagement With Unseen Ring Exchange Video
excerpt: The Sandalwood power couple celebrated a decade since their Goa engagement, with Radhika sharing a never-before-seen video just weeks before Yash's highly anticipated film Toxic hits theaters.
body:
• Radhika Pandit shared a previously unseen video of her and Yash's engagement ring exchange from their August 12, 2016 ceremony in Goa.
  • The couple, who first met on the set of Kannada TV show Nandagokul in 2004, are celebrating their 10th engagement anniversary.
  • The milestone comes ahead of Yash's much-anticipated film Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups, directed by Geetu Mohandas.
  • Yash is also set to play Lankesh Raavan in Nitish Tiwari's Ramayana alongside Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi.

Radhika Pandit marked a decade of togetherness with husband Yash on Tuesday by sharing a never-before-seen video from their engagement ceremony, giving fans an intimate glimpse of one of Sandalwood's most celebrated love stories.

The video, posted on Instagram, shows the ring exchange from the couple's engagement on August 12, 2016, in Goa. Radhika captioned the post with a heartfelt message: "You will always be my favourite YES." The clip quickly drew an outpouring of affection from fans across India.

A Love Story That Began on Television

Yash and Radhika's romance traces back more than two decades. They first crossed paths on the sets of the 2004 Kannada television series Nandagokul, though their initial meeting was anything but love at first sight. Radhika has spoken in interviews about finding her co-star full of attitude, while Yash has recalled being reserved around her.

https://x.com/BangaloreTimes1/status/2087425150346301590

But the two kept ending up in the same orbit. They shared screen space in several projects, including the Kannada films Moggina Manasu (2008), Drama (2012), Mr and Mrs Ramachari (2014), and Santhu Straight Forward (2016). Their on-screen chemistry eventually mirrored what was developing off-screen, and the couple began dating.

They got engaged in a ceremony in Goa on August 12, 2016, and tied the knot on December 9 of the same year in Bangalore. The couple are now parents to two children — daughter Ayra and son Yatharv.

"You will always be my favourite YES."

— Radhika Pandit, on their 10th engagement anniversary

Toxic and Ramayana Keep Yash in the Spotlight

The anniversary post comes at a significant moment in Yash's career. The KGF star is preparing for the release of Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups, directed by acclaimed Malayalam filmmaker Geetu Mohandas. The film, set against the backdrop of Goa's drug underworld, explores themes of power, love, and betrayal. Yash plays a character named Raya, and the cast includes Bollywood actors Kiara Advani and Nayanthara.

The project has been building anticipation since its teaser dropped on Yash's 40th birthday in January, showcasing a grittier, more intense avatar for the actor. Toxic is being positioned as one of the year's major pan-India releases, reflecting Yash's crossover appeal after the KGF franchise turned him into a nationwide star.

Beyond Toxic, Yash has been cast as Lankesh Raavan in Nitish Tiwari's Ramayana, a big-budget mythological epic that also features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi as Goddess Sita, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The dual assignments cement Yash's standing as one of Indian cinema's most bankable leading men.

A Milestone for Sandalwood's First Couple

For fans of Kannada cinema, the Yash-Radhika partnership represents something more than celebrity romance. Their journey from television co-stars to one of the industry's most visible couples tracks the rise of Sandalwood itself — from a regional film industry to one whose biggest stars now command pan-India audiences. That Radhika chose to mark the milestone with a private, previously unshared moment rather than a polished public statement only added to the warmth of the celebration.
